name: vcf-framework
description: Vibe Coder Framework — solo-dev gate-mode framework for shipping production-quality features end-to-end. 10-step doctrine, 8 gate commands, /clear between gates.

plugins.name: vcf-framework
plugins.description: 10-step doctrine, 8 gate commands: /vcf-framework:context, :brainstorm, :prd, :plan, :build, :slice-audit, :final-audit, :closeout. Plus :overview for reference. Each gate reads upstream artifact, writes its own, instructs user to /clear before next gate. In-loop kaizen + sprint sub-steps live inside :build.
